text: Liam's knee operation is booked for 2 November 2026. He's dreading the anaesthetic more than the surgery itself. Remind me to text him the night before.
Dinner at Chiara's on Saturday. She's gone fully vegan since the summer, so I'll bring the lemon tart from the bakery rather than the cheesecake.
Pooja is coeliac, properly coeliac, not just avoiding bread. Worth remembering for the housewarming on 14 November.
Called Mum. Uncle Delroy is out of hospital after his gallbladder op and is home with Aunt Fatima now. Must ring him this weekend.
Noor's housewarming has been called off because the move fell through at the last minute. She sounded gutted about the flat.
Henrik only drinks alcohol-free beer these days, and he's particular about it. Apparently Lucky Saint is the only one he rates.
Spoke to Gabriel after his appointment on Tuesday. The scan came back clear, he's relieved. His wife Saskia is still a bit shaken though.
Picked up the prescription and booked my own dentist check-up for 3rd of December.
Rahul invited us to his 40th on 22 November, a curry night at the place on Mill Road. He's allergic to cashews, so keep that in mind if we bring anything homemade.
Nora mentioned she's been on a low-FODMAP diet for her stomach since August. Garlic and onion are off the table.

Ivan's mum had a hip replacement last week. He's driving up every weekend to help and seems exhausted. I should send him a message on Friday to check how she's doing. He also mentioned she can only eat soft food for now and is sick of soup, so maybe a care box with those little custard pots she likes.

Deepa (Dee to everyone at work) is hosting a Diwali dinner on 8 November. Partners welcome. It's all vegetarian, her mum is cooking most of it, and Dee said not to bring wine because her dad doesn't drink. Sweets from the Indian bakery on the high street would be perfect instead. Don't forget to RSVP by Sunday.
Graham's biopsy results should be back by 30/10. Don't forget to call him that evening.
Florin loves a proper negroni, nothing fancy. Hates anything with coconut.
Jess and Tiago are throwing a joint birthday party in March 2027. Early warning only, no date yet.

Yasmin's brother Nasser is in hospital with appendicitis. Surgery went fine on Sunday, but he'll be in until at least Thursday. She's worried about him missing his exams, which start on 1st of December, and their parents are abroad so she's doing all the hospital visits on her own. I should offer to drive her in one evening this week.
Lin can't do dairy at all. Oat milk in her coffee, always.
Zofia's dog Pierogi had an operation on his paw yesterday. She was in bits on the phone. Remind me to ask Zofia how he's recovering on Monday.

Eva's leaving do is at the Crown on 5th of December, from six. I said I'd bring the card round for everyone to sign. Eva's off to a new job in Leeds, starting on 6 January 2027, and she's nervous about knowing nobody up there. Her boyfriend is staying here until the summer.
Matilda is pregnant again! Due in May 2027. She's off caffeine and finding it miserable.
Aneesh had his cataract surgery on 12 October and is already back to reading. Very chuffed about it.
Need to buy Bruno something for his housewarming. He's mad about natural wine, the cloudier the better.
Nikolai told me his dad is having a heart bypass on 19/11. He's trying to stay upbeat but clearly nervous. I must check in with him the week after.
Ayesha doesn't drink, so pick up some of that fancy elderflower pressé before Friday's dinner.
Coffee with Finn. His partner Alfie got a place on the chef's course he applied for, starting in January. Finn says Alfie's cooking already tastes like a restaurant.
Niamh's thirtieth on 27 November at hers. Dress code is 'sparkly'. She hinted that she'd love a decent cocktail shaker.
Mrs Johnson next door is having her other knee done in the new year. She asked if I could feed the cat for a few days while she's in.
Lunch with Saskia and Gabriel. They're doing a big Sunday roast on 16 November to say thanks to everyone who helped while he was ill. Saskia is gluten-free, he isn't.
Groceries, gym, and finally sorted the boiler service. Quiet day.
Rahul's wife, Dr Pooja Chen, is on night shifts at the hospital all through December. He said she survives on chai and very little sleep.
Liam texted: the op went well and he's home. Physio starts on 10 November. I should drop round with some soup next week, he hates hospital food.

Henrik and his girlfriend are hosting a crayfish party on 29 August next year, a Swedish thing. He's already planning the menu: crayfish, schnapps, silly hats and songs. He said it's the one night a year he's allowed to be loud. Henrik's girlfriend is allergic to shellfish, which is a bit of a problem, so she'll be on the meatballs.
Delroy's recovery is slower than expected. He's frustrated about not being able to drive until mid-December. Remind me to call him on Thursday.

Chiara asked whether we'd come to her engagement dinner. It's on 6th of February 2027 at her parents' place in Bristol. Her mum is doing a huge Italian spread, and Chiara says there will be vegan options for her, thank goodness.
Jess hates mushrooms with a passion. Do not put them in anything.

Noor rang about the hospital. Her grandad's had a fall and they're keeping him in for observation. She sounded tired. She's been there every evening since Friday and her mum is struggling to cope. I said I'd come by on Wednesday with food. Should also message her sister Eva to see if she needs a break covering visits.
Got invited to the Le family's Christmas drinks on 20 December. Bring something non-alcoholic for the kids.
Gabriel's back at work from 4 November, part-time to start.
Tiago's tonsillectomy got postponed again, now pushed to January 2027. He's annoyed because he'd booked the time off.
Ivan said his mum is back walking with a frame. Big improvement since the op.
Aneesh mentioned he's trying keto, so no bread basket at Friday's dinner. He's lost a stone already.
Florin's birthday is 14 May. He wants a proper cast-iron pan, he keeps dropping hints.
Fatima has an ENT appointment on the 18th. I'm driving her there and waiting.
Pooja's dinner party is off, she has the flu. We'll rearrange for after the 15th.
Don't forget to order the cake for Mum's 70th on 3rd of January 2027. She only likes lemon drizzle, nothing with cream.

Nikolai's dad came through the bypass fine. Long recovery ahead, and the family are taking turns at the hospital. Nikolai sounded wiped out but relieved. His dad is home from the 28th if all goes well, and his mum is already panicking about the diet changes the cardiologist gave them. Low salt, no fried food, much less red meat. Remind me to send Nikolai that heart-healthy recipe book.
Booked my flu jab for 1 November.

Matilda and her husband are hosting a baby shower in April. She asked me to help with the food since half her friends are vegetarian. I should ask Matilda what she can and can't eat now, as the list keeps changing.
Finn just found out he's lactose intolerant. Explains a lot about our pizza nights.
Saskia mentioned Gabriel's follow-up appointment is on 2/12. She's worried it'll be bad news again. Remind me to text her the day after to see how it went.
Yasmin can't eat sesame, it's a proper allergy, EpiPen and everything.

Housewarming at Bruno and Nora's new place on 15 November. They've moved into a two-bed near the park. Bruno asked everyone to bring a dish because he's doing the drinks. I'm doing my dal since Nora is vegetarian. Their cat Biscuit is apparently hiding under the bed until the boxes go. Nora said her parents are coming down from Glasgow for it too, first time they've seen the place.
Lin's surgery date has come through: 9 January 2027 for her shoulder. She's a nervous wreck about it already. Must message her nearer the time.
Phone call with Uncle Graham. His heart scan was fine and he's back at the allotment.
Zofia says Pierogi is back to chasing squirrels. Cone off on Friday.

Alfie is hosting a tasting menu night for friends on 7 December to practise for the course. He asked for allergies in advance. I'm fine, but Jess and Lin will need sorting: no mushrooms for Jess, and no dairy for Lin. Finn says Alfie has been testing dishes every night for a fortnight and the kitchen looks like a bomb site. I need to tell Alfie about both by the end of the week.
Deepa's dad is having a stent fitted next month. She's being brave about it, but I know she's scared. Remind me to ask Deepa when the date is confirmed.
Eva's leaving do went really well. Need to send her the photos and ask how the first week at the new place is going.
Niamh's party was cancelled because her flatmate tested positive. She's planning something smaller on 4 December instead.

Mental note: the Osei barbecue is on 31 May 2027, assuming Ayesha's back from her trip by then. Her husband Nasser said they'll do halal everything and plenty of grilled veg. Ayesha's trip is a month in Pakistan for her cousin's wedding, flying out 20 April 2027. Must remember to ask her for some proper mangoes if she's bringing any back.
